title: VibeVoice
description: Voice-cloning TTS powered by aoi-ot/VibeVoice-Large. Accepts a text prompt and a reference audio clip (base64) and returns synthesized speech at 24 kHz as Opus/MP3/WAV (Opus default). Supports English and Chinese.

input.name: Default CFG Scale
input.description: Default classifier-free guidance strength (override per job via input.cfg_scale)

input.name: Default DDPM Steps
input.description: Default diffusion denoising steps (override per job via input.ddpm_steps)

input.name: Default Speaker Label
input.description: Default speaker prefix for single-speaker prompts (override per job via input.speaker_label)

input.name: Default Output Format
input.description: Default response encoding: opus, mp3, or wav (override per job via input.output_format)
